{{RV|type=command

|descr= Kick the player controlling the provided unit from the server.

|s1= [[kickPlayer]] [unit, kickMessage]

|p1= unit: [[Object]] - the player to kick

|r1= [[Boolean]] - [[true]] on success, [[false]] otherwise

if (not isPlayerSupporter _dude) then

	kickPlayer [_dude, "Give money to BI or else!"];
};
